The paint never chips and color never dulls. I LOVE these nails because I change polish like I change panties..Lol. Not really but u get the analogy.. lol. I love that the nails last long, but not too long as too not damage my natural nails when I remove them. I love KISS!!
I was able to file them down and it still looked great. I love them. The glue is also surprisingly strong!!! Def recommend

Very pretty! I wish they had skinnier sizes for my fingers I had to file several. U can still see ur real nail even fully cut down (at the top) because of the shape. They r pretty though and everyone has complimented me on them. I glue mine down. The silver ones do pop off more easily and I have noticed my finger nail turning green on the silver ones I think because they don’t bend well to ur nail and water gets underneath causing bacteria. So deff watch out for that. I did have to cut the lengt

I didn't expect them to be as long as they were, which is my own problem, but even putting them on with extra hold glue they still consistently popped off. The flimsiness of the nail didn't allow me to do the simplest things. I would rather just splurge and get them done professionally and know I can do simple things like pull a card out of my wallet without my nail flying across the room. They are a super cute design though.
First time buyer and first time I tried these Nd I got sooo many compliments!!! In love idk how things will be once I remove them and o did buy an additional glue but it’s soo worth it!
I hate them.  Way too long and they got to narrow as you get to the tip. I understand the shape us coffin but they are just too narrow at the top and they bend quite easily.  Wont buy again.

First time, Love it! I work in a health professional setting so no artificial nails and painted nails. But I really wanted something temporary for a weekend event. I don't like gluing fake nails due to damage of natural nail when taking off but the adhesive tape offered was perfect. I love that you can adjust length of nail by triming and how natural it looks. I had no issues with it throughout the weekend. Felt natural, did not hinder me in any way. Taking it off was very simple and damage free

I have been buying Kiss nails for two months now since they are so cute and last me at least 2-3 weeks. Used to get my nails done and it would often cost me 35 bucks at least every 2 weeks. These are so much easier and cheaper to maintain. Love them.
I bought these for me but my mom liked them so I gave them to her. I guess I’ll buy this set in one of the other colors haha
Love these nails. They are so beautiful.

They’re thick so don’t bend or deform like another brand I tried. It comes with stickies and glue.  I only wanted to wear for the weekend so tried the stickies.  Easy to apply.  However, it didn’t last.  Nails started popping off as I was as getting ready for the evening out! Luckily I had the glue and

I am a server and even after a busy shift my nails remain firmly in place because the glue is great quality. I actually prefer their glue over higher price glue I’d purchased at a beauty store. reviews.t: Fall off as soon as you add water :(
reviews.x: If I could give this less stars I would. Brought them on vacation with me so I wouldn't break any during travel. I followed all instructions and put the nails on, waited about 4 hours and took a shower. 4 of the 10 nails fell right off. It was really disappointing. I have had good experiences with this company before and maybe I just got a dud, however, apparently showering with these nails is not an option.

the nails are extremely cute! no lie about that but the nails didnt last long. 3 came off in 1 day and i was careful with everything i was doing. i work in retail so i picked everything up slowly and all and the crazy thing is that my nails started popping off wayy after i clocked out of work what i was literally doing nothing.  i glued 1 nail twice and it still came off. yea ill just go get my nails done

I like these nails. They're cute and the design is different and flashy. The nails are a little thin which makes me feel like they're not sturdy. They're pretty long for my taste so I trimmed them  down and filed them which was a easy process. Cutting and trimming the silver ones did chip off a teeny spot of the silver though so be careful! But it's not noticeable. I would re purchase these again

I cannot get enough of these press on nails! This is my 2nd time using them and I am constantly getting compliments. They’ve lasted a good 2 weeks , only thing is after a few days the shape starts to turn into almost oval or almond shape.. which is perfectly fine with me. They are also a little too long for my taste so I do cut them and they are extremely easy to file.

I put these babies on in less than 20 minutes!!  I would show what my natural nails looked like before BUT it is the holidays and I don't want to scare anyone!!  They are long and these pics were taken when I filed them down a little!  I love the ease and convenience of Kiss line of press ons!  I have named these "Black Beauty"!!  Happy Holidays!!!

This product is very nice and glamorous but they arr very long compared to natural nail length. I used the adhesive tabs and the important thing to remember is to make sure your nails are completely dry and slightly filled to create a surface for either the glue or tabs to attach to. I didn't do thid and they were popping off left and right.

Very pretty, perfect for my costume. Absolutely love the matte black. These are super duper long! Which was perfect for my costume but not for everyday. I was able to trim them down though and I think they still look quite nice. I like that the little kit comes with glue, a file, and a little wooden cuticle pusher.

The diamond nails are very sturdy and have a thick shell but the matte black nails aren’t made as well. They’re a little thinner so bend easily if you were to hit your finger on something. But I guess that’s better than them breaking. The do look really nice though!

reviews.t: Not my favorite Style of kiss
reviews.x: I buy and wear Kiss nails exclusively nowadays. My salon trips are over! This particular style fits weird and doesn't get me as many compliments as others. The shape is off. Try the Kiss  Goldfinger style if you like a longer nail. They are Beautiful!

Followed the directions using the glue, but I constantly had to reglue them on. They popped off constantly. Also they were a lot longer than I expected which made texting and typing incredibly difficult. I took these off after a week of wearing them.

I absolutely loved this nail kit! The black nails were wonderful in their matte appearance! The embellished, metallic nails didn't adhere quite as well as the black matte. But, overall this was a fantastic purchase. I would buy it again!

claims.text: Many reviewers love these nails and say they last at least a week or longer, with several reporting no breakage or lost nails.
Reviewers frequently mention receiving lots of compliments on the nails.
The glue is often praised as strong and long-lasting, though some reviewers report nails popping off or falling off, especially after water exposure.
Some reviewers find the nails too long or too narrow at the tip, and a few note they bend or feel flimsy.
Several reviewers appreciate that the nails can be filed down and still look good.
